searched.title: Bambu Filament Technical Data Sheet V1.0: TPU 90A
searched.note: All 5 pages read (text layer, per page): Basic Info, Specifications, Recommended Printing Settings, Physical Properties, Mechanical Properties, Other Physical and Chemical Properties, Specimen Test, Disclaimer. Glass transition, crystallization, Vicat softening ("Vicar" in the TDS), both heat deflection rows and all four bending rows read "N/A"; no hardness and no filament length are given.

searched.title: Bambu Filament Technical Data Sheet V1.0: TPU 85A
searched.note: All 5 pages read; same layout and same "N/A" rows as the TPU 90A TDS. Nozzle Size "0.6, 0.8 mm" (TPU 90A: "0.4, 0.6, 0.8 mm"); every other print setting equals the TPU 90A TDS.

searched.title: Bambu TPU 90A Material Safety Data Sheet (report ESZ2411110058C00102RM1)
searched.note: All 12 pages read (bilingual Chinese/English, prepared for Bambu Lab by EMTEK (Suzhou)). Section 3: Thermoplastic Polyurethane ≥98 % by wt, additive ≤2; section 9: "No data available" for melting point, density and every other physical datum; section 14: no UN number or transport class. Model "U03-xx".

searched.title: Bambu TPU 85A Material Safety Data Sheet (report ESZ2411110058C00101RM1)
searched.note: All 12 pages read; identical to the TPU 90A SDS except the report number and model ("U04-xx").

searched.title: Bambu Lab Filament Hex Code Table: TPU 90A
searched.note: One page, 8 colours (Blaze and Frozen as two-stop vertical gradients, checked on a rendering of the page): read for the published hex codes (the "hex" list), not for spec keys.

searched.title: Bambu Lab Filament Hex Code Table: TPU 85A
searched.note: One page, 5 colours: read for the published hex codes (the "hex" list), not for spec keys.

searched.title: Filament guide - Printer, Nozzle, AMS, Build Plate, Glue Compatibility and Required Parameters
searched.note: Printer (row "PLA, PETG, TPU …"), nozzle (rows "TPU 85A" and "TPU 90A"), AMS (row "TPU" and the "Too soft" list), build plate and glue (rows "TPU") and storage (row "TPU") tables; corroboration and relations only. Its HDT, impact and tensile columns are star ratings, not numbers.

searched.title: Filament Drying Recommendations
searched.note: Appendix I row "TPU 85A、TPU 90A": heatbed 90 °C 16 h, forced-air oven 70 °C 8 h, AMS 2 Pro 65 °C 12 h (may not fully dry TPU), AMS HT 75 °C 18 h. Section 1.3: static drying mode not suitable for TPU.

documents.title: Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS, build plate and glue compatibility

notes: Option scope: density, melting temperature, the nozzle sizes and the X-Y printed-specimen tensile, elongation and impact values differ between the two TDSs, so each is stored on its Product value ("TPU 85A" 573761693833371650, "TPU 90A" 573761693833371649). Every other TDS value is identical in both TDSs and is stored once at product scope, citing the TPU 90A TDS with the TPU 85A locator in its note.

Mechanical keys hold the TDS X-Y printed-specimen values; the registry has one key per scope, so the Z values (TPU 90A: tensile 10.1 ± 0.6 MPa, elongation > 350%, impact 87.3 kJ/m²; TPU 85A: tensile 10.5 ± 0.6 MPa, elongation > 350%, impact 88.5 kJ/m²) are not stored. Density and melting temperature are raw-material properties from the TDS Physical Properties table and sit under material.* / thermal.*, apart from the printed-specimen mechanical.* rows.

TDS facts with no registry key are not stored: Young's modulus (TPU 90A X-Y 5.3 ± 0.7 MPa, Z 4.4 ± 0.6 MPa; TPU 85A X-Y 6.8 ± 0.7 MPa, Z 5.2 ± 0.6 MPa), melt index (TPU 90A 9.36 ± 2.6, TPU 85A 8.76 ± 2.6 g/10 min at 210 °C, 2.16 kg), saturated water absorption (TPU 90A 0.61%, TPU 85A 0.67%, 25 °C, 55% RH), crystallization temperature N/A, spool material ABS (temperature resistance 90 °C), spool size 200 × 67 mm, printing and storage humidity < 20% RH (sealed, with desiccant), glue (Bambu Liquid Glue / Glue Stick), retraction length 0.4 - 0.8 mm, retraction speed 10 - 30 mm/s, chamber temperature 25 - 45 °C, max overhang angle ~ 40°, max bridging length 10 mm, support material "Turn on", printer heatbed drying 90 °C 16 h, the advice not to anneal TPU prints, odor, skin hazards, chemical stability, solubility, chemical resistance, flammability and combustion products.

The TDS recommended chamber temperature (25 - 45 °C) is not written to thermal.chamber_temp: the key describes a printer capability, not a filament print setting. The TDS nozzle sizes are written to extrusion.supported_nozzle_diameters per Product value (TPU 90A 0.4, 0.6, 0.8 mm; TPU 85A 0.6, 0.8 mm), as in the TPU 95A HF file and the other filament files, and are also carried by the nozzle relations.
Elongation at break and print speed are kept as text ("> 650%", "> 700%", "< 200 mm/s"): the TDS gives only a bound, and storing the number would claim an equality the document does not make.

SDS facts with no registry key are not stored: models "U03-xx" (TPU 90A) and "U04-xx" (TPU 85A), "No harm to the body", no hazard symbols, no UN number or transport classification. The SDS section 5 says "The product itself is not flammable", the TDS says "Flammability Flammable"; neither has a key and neither is stored (for review). The SDS is prepared for Bambu Lab by a testing lab (EMTEK (Suzhou)); no SDS value is stored as a spec.
Marketing prose proves no number: "The Softest Bambu TPU", "With a higher hardness", "Exceptional Wear Resistance" and the content-block claims are not stored as values.

not_published: both TDSs state "N/A" for the glass transition temperature, the Vicat softening temperature, the heat deflection temperature (1.8 MPa and 0.45 MPa rows), and the bending strength and bending modulus; filament length and hardness are stated in none of the documents searched. The product names carry "85A" and "90A", the usual Shore A hardness grades, but no document states a hardness value or a test method, so mechanical.hardness is not inferred from the names (for review, as for TPU 95A HF).

Hex: all 13 store Colour values have a published hex: 8 from the TPU 90A table, 5 from the TPU 85A table. The two blacks are matched by the store's own variant pairing (Black (51103) only with TPU 90A, Black (51107) only with TPU 85A). Blaze and Frozen carry two stops each ("hexes", gradient).
No in-the-box list: no official packing list exists for this filament (the store page has no What's in the Box section).
material.diameter_tolerance (± 0.05 mm) is the store page's own row (Product Features › bullet 6); the TDSs give no tolerance, so it is not restated here and not marked not_published.

The store Download block links "TPU 90A Filament RoHS" and "TPU 85A Filament RoHS" certificates that were not cached and not read, so safety.certifications is neither curated nor marked not_published. The store page also links the wiki guides /en/h2/h2d-tpu-printing-guide and /en/h2/manual/soft-and-hard-filament-multi-material-printing-guide, and the TPU wiki page links six printing guides; none was cached or read.

Store FAQ (6.Safety Tips) says the filament "is not food-grade"; the same list also says it "contains highly hygroscopic wood fibers", which contradicts both TDSs (composition: thermoplastic polyurethane) and both SDSs (thermoplastic polyurethane ≥98 % by wt) and reads as a copied sentence. No registry key holds either, and neither is stored.

Merge check: the store page gives a product-scope not_found row for material.density (an expected key); the curated density is option-scoped, and mergeCurated keeps that product-scope not_found row beside the two option rows (the package builder drops such a row when another row supplies the key, mergeCurated does not). For the integrator.

Adjudication against the second extraction (170 field disagreements; every fact present in one file only or stated differently was re-read in the cached TDSs, SDSs, hex tables, wiki pages and store page). Same fact written differently (56), this file's form kept unless said: the TDS locators (10; "p.2, Properties › Physical / Mechanical Properties › row"), the hex locators (13; row and column checked in both hex tables), the FAQ relation locators (15), the relation target encoding (8; H2D as family model_h2d per compat-targets, "X Series", "P Series", "A Series" as family rows with no family id since the FAQ does not say which printers they cover), the resolved target handles of the AMS HT, AMS 2 Pro, AMS, AMS lite, H2S and H2C relations (8; each the compat-targets resolution and a manifest row), and material.type, which stays the TDS p.3 Composition cell "Thermoplastic polyurethane" (the document's own words, not the abbreviation "TPU"). The PLA/PETG multi-material relation's label is rewritten to the quote's own words, "PLA/PETG (multi-material printing)" (neither file's label: "Bambu … series" is not in the FAQ bullet; the second's "on H2D / H2C" is this row's condition). Present in one file only or stated differently (114), each kept as this file has it after checking the documents: material.spool_type stays the unverified store bullet "Includes High Temperature Reusable Spool" (the TDS rows "Spool Material ABS (Temperature resistance 90 °C)" and "Spool Size Diameter: 200 mm; Height: 67 mm" give the spool's material and size, not its type, and the second extraction's verified value paraphrases them); the two compat.statement rows and the nozzle relations (the store FAQ's Printer Compatibility and Nozzle Compatibility bullets, verbatim); the build plate and glue relations (TDS p.1, Build Plate Type and Glue rows); material.diameter_tolerance is not restated (the store page's own verified row, Product Features › bullet 6, already carries ± 0.05 mm at the same rank, and no TDS states a tolerance); mechanical.hardness stays not_published: "85A" and "90A" are only in the product names and TDS titles, and no cached document states a hardness value or method, so the second extraction's unverified "85A" / "90A" are not written. Taken from the second extraction in an earlier pass, after checking the documents: extrusion.supported_nozzle_diameters per Product value (each TDS's Nozzle Size row) and target_kind "material" for the PLA/PETG relation ("filament" is not a product_relations target_kind). Also corrected: the six mechanical test_condition strings no longer say the specimens were "not annealed" (the TDS only advises against annealing TPU prints). material.net_weight is written in kg, the TDS's own figure (1 kg; stored as 1000 g). Quote checker: its 17 not_found lines (the TDS quotes for density, melting temperature, tensile strength, nozzle and bed temperature, printing speed, cooling fan, build plate, nozzle size and the plate and glue relations) are verbatim in the cached TDS text; its HTML tag stripper reads the TDS's "< 20% RH" … "> 650%" (TPU 85A: "> 700%") as one tag and deletes the text between them.
